name: horde
description: Run a mission too big for one agent: turns your coding agent into a director that raises a horde — workers in worktrees, one ticket each, a one-shot review of every change that can send work back but never approve it, an architect subagent with a veto over the graph, legislate that writes each territory's law down, and a retrospective that closes the mission out.

args: const f=process.argv[1];if(!require("fs").existsSync(f)){console.error("horde: "+f+" is not reachable from this environment (a host path inside a container?), so horde did not run");process.exit(0)}const r=require("child_process").spawnSync(process.execPath,process.argv.slice(1),{stdio:"inherit"});process.exit(r.status===null?1:r.status)
